theorem anonymous_target
  {T : NNReal} (hT : 0 < T) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (w : Fin (2 ^ m) → ℝ) (z : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℝ) :
  have s :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m);
  have t :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n);
  have P := fun k => ∑ i, if t i.succ ≤ s k then z i else 0;
  ∑ i, w (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicElementaryRefinement.coarseCell hmn i) * z i =
    ∑ j, w j * (P j.succ - P j.castSucc)

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicElementaryRefinement.coarseCell : {level targetLevel :
    ℕ} →
  level ≤ targetLevel → Fin (2 ^ targetLevel) → Fin (2 ^ level) :=
fun {level targetLevel} hle j =>
  ⟨↑j /
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicElementaryRefinement.refinementFactor level
        targetLevel,
    ⋯⟩

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh : NNReal →
  ℕ → NNReal :=
fun T level => T / ↑(2 ^ level)

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes : NNReal →
  (cellCount : ℕ) → Fin (cellCount + 1) → NNReal :=
fun delta cellCount i => ↑↑i * delta

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicElementaryRefinement.refinementFactor : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun level targetLevel => 2 ^ (targetLevel - level)
